invariant_training_contract.learning_rate: read unchanged from frozen 10105 checkpoint config
invariant_training_contract.batch_size: read unchanged from frozen 10105 checkpoint config
invariant_training_contract.sample_order: same protected split and train_pool ordering

parity_gate.definition: exact canonical current weighted legal-action MSE
parity_gate.requirement: all 8 refit state_dicts must be bitwise identical to frozen @17315 ensemble before evaluating alternate objectives

candidates.target: raw CFR Advantage divided per state by max absolute legal Advantage, epsilon floor 1e-6
candidates.rationale: regret matching is invariant to positive per-state target scaling; remove cross-state magnitude heterogeneity without changing ideal policy

candidates.action_loss: within each state, total MSE weight 50% positive-regret legal actions and 50% non-positive legal actions when both groups exist; otherwise uniform legal-action MSE
candidates.rationale: prevent one/few positive-regret actions from being diluted by many non-positive legal actions
test scale heterogeneity and positive-action dilution jointly

protected_holdout_metrics: weighted mean TV to stored-CFR target policy
fixed_primary_metrics: on the frozen 4676 current-fallback/target-positive states: residual ensemble fallback fraction
CFR-best positive-sign vote mean across 8 members

gates.parity: A refit bitwise equals source @17315 ensemble

interpretation.pass: candidate objective improves sign/fallback failure without materially degrading held-out CFR fidelity; candidate proceeds to frozen pathology and direct-play validation
interpretation.no_pass: current architecture/representation or richer objective research is required; do not resume long training

prohibitions: no architecture-size changes in this gate
no candidate definitions added after results
